name: A Quartet Of Love And Scars
source:
'A Quartet Of Love And Scars' is an anthology of 4 stories revolving around the theme of queer love and its difficulties, each of the stories are written separately from one another, so you can enjoy them in any order.

A smitten rabbit finds himself in another world, forcing him to confront his feelings. -Written by Hell-o World

A horned lizard too afraid to share his secret to his friend and crush. - Written by GeNasis

A tiger stranded in the middle of nowhere gets help from a kind stranger. - Written by Flylin

A lonely cat mourns his last love before a surprise takes him off his feet. - Written by Toto

[From [url=https://flylin1.itch.io/a-quartet-of-love-and-scars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《爱与伤痕四重奏》是一部围绕酷儿爱情及其困境的四个故事的选集，每个故事都是分开写的，因此你可以按任何顺序欣赏它们。

一只被迷住的兔子发现自己身处另一个世界，迫使他面对自己的感受。——作者：你好世界

一只角蜥蜴不敢向他的朋友和暗恋对象分享他的秘密。——作者：GeNasis一只被困在偏僻地方的老虎得到了一位好心陌生人的帮助。——作者：飞林

一只孤独的猫哀悼他最后的爱人，然后一场意外让他兴奋不已。——托托写的

[来自[url=https://flylin1.itch.io/a-quartet-of-love-and-scars]Itch.io[/url]]
